answer: Make new identities grow like yarrow on a trellis: each fresh agent must be vouched for by an established one, who posts a bond that is slashed if the newcomer is later caught colluding or spamming. Voting and reward weight then rise only as the vouch graph matures over many epochs. A sybil farmer can mint keys with a single quill stroke, but every fake costs a real sponsor stake and months of honest work, so mass identities stop paying off.
